name: Static UI
description: Embeddable single-page DSM-5-TR checklist UI. Vanilla JS, no build step. Exposes createDiagnosisModule() for the Insight Dashboard. Reads meta_contract from /diagnosis/_meta for optimistic display, never reimplements DSM logic in JS.

name: API Surface
description: FastAPI composition root, three route seams, and standalone app wiring. Tiny REST interface hiding the clinical logic. Eight routes total: health, ready, browser page, _meta, _csrf, module discovery, audit, and per-patient REST. Clinician-authoritative — model never auto-decides.

name: Clinical Domain
description: Pure DSM-5-TR evaluation engine. CRITERIA list (9 items: A1-A6, B1, C1, D1), evaluate() pure function, and meta_contract() rule primitives. Zero I/O, zero side effects. The module-local readiness probe also lives here since it is a pure function with no external service calls.

name: Data & Infrastructure
description: SQLite repository (WAL journal, thread-safe DiagnosisStore), patient identity adapter (canonical INSIGHT registry lookup), HMAC-SHA256 CSRF token, auth service delegation (Insight session + role enforcement), and the frozen settings adapter (only place to add a new env knob).

name: Tests
description: Ponytail-style test suite using stdlib unittest plus threading HTTP server harnesses. No external test framework. Covers: criteria rules, REST contract, audit seam, clinician-authority invariant, auth rejection, CSRF, persistence, patient identity, route-seam split, module discovery, embeddable UI, readiness probe, and settings adapter.

name: Documentation
description: Canonical REST API contract (locked against live router), deep-module handoff guide for future LLMs/humans, and user-facing README.
